skill.acrobatics.description.message: Balance, tumbling, controlled falls, narrow footing, and rapid positioning.

skill.alchemy.description.message: Identify reagents and produce medicines, stimulants, toxins, and magical compounds.

skill.ancient-lore.description.message: Recognize lost civilizations, relic functions, old routes, and historical context.

skill.archery.description.message: Use bows, crossbows, unusual string weapons, ammunition, and aimed projectiles.

skill.astrogation.description.message: Plan routes, interpret Starways, and evaluate navigation costs and uncertainty.

skill.athletics.description.message: Run, jump, climb, swim, lift, and sustain demanding physical movement.

skill.command.description.message: Coordinate crew priorities, communicate orders, and sustain organized action.

skill.cooking.description.message: Plan meals, preserve provisions, handle unusual diets, and support morale.

skill.crafting.description.message: Fabricate and improve equipment, ammunition, tools, fittings, and replacement parts.

skill.deception.description.message: Create plausible false impressions through words, disguise, timing, and evidence.

skill.defense.description.message: Guard, parry, use shields, protect positions, and apply defensive techniques.

skill.enchantment.description.message: Design, bind, identify, maintain, and remove persistent magical effects.

skill.engineering.description.message: Diagnose, operate, maintain, and repair ship machinery and infrastructure.

skill.eva.description.message: Operate suits, tethers, handholds, and propellant while working outside a hull.

skill.gunnery.description.message: Operate personal firearms and manually controlled mounted weapons.

skill.insight.description.message: Interpret behavior, intent, uncertainty, and social evidence.

skill.language-literacy.description.message: Speak, understand, read, write, translate, and decipher learned languages and scripts.

skill.magic.description.message: Understand spell theory and control known magic when explicit access is available.

skill.medicine.description.message: Diagnose, stabilize, treat, and support recovery from injury and illness.

skill.melee.description.message: Fight unarmed or with hand-held weapons and learned close-combat techniques.

skill.merchant.description.message: Appraise goods, read markets, manage contracts, and detect pricing fraud.

skill.negotiation.description.message: Bargain, mediate disputes, propose terms, and seek voluntary concessions.

skill.piloting.description.message: Control ship maneuvers, docking, evasion, approaches, and disengagement.

skill.psionics.description.message: Understand psychic theory and control known techniques with explicit access.

skill.rigging.description.message: Deploy sails, tethers, lines, fittings, and load-bearing arrangements.

skill.salvage.description.message: Assess wrecks, recover material, preserve evidence, and avoid unstable hazards.

skill.sensors.description.message: Operate detection systems, identify signatures, and distinguish evidence from noise.

skill.stealth.description.message: Reduce observable evidence through positioning, timing, noise control, and concealment.

skill.xenology.description.message: Study unfamiliar organisms, ecologies, physiology, behavior, and contamination.
